{{Top|leg}}
A '''power pivot''' was a maneuver that [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] would perform where the pilot would use the [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter's]] lateral [[Engine/Legends|thrusters]] to quickly turn the ship around by 180 degrees.
